notes: Everything was read on www.reefwalker.com.au (the bare domain does not load over https; it redirects to www). Image sizes were taken from the dimensions the pages declare, nothing was downloaded. Logo: the header logo, 854 by 186 as declared in the page metadata, recorded without the resize parameter so it is the original file; the footer copy is smaller (643 by 140), so it was not used. No heroImage given: the facts file already uses Kalbarri Cliffs (Large).png (1920 by 1080, boat under the cliffs); alternatives are Sunset Cruise Full (compressed).png (1920 by 977, passengers at sunset) and Reefwalker Cruise (Large).png (1916 by 1033, boat at the red cliffs). Videos: none. The site links no YouTube or Vimeo channel and embeds no player. The home page header plays a 17 second background loop hosted by Squarespace (file name 'Header Clip.mp4'), but only an HLS playlist address exists for it (https://video.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/628f100fbc44a2412c17576b/513e7215-ddd8-4711-b55e-fb8721aa4d1f/playlist.m3u8), not an .mp4 URL, so it is not listed. Trips: there are no separate trip pages. Each trip's photos are its card on the tours page and its card on the home page; the whale trip also has the whale pictures from the gallery strip on the tours page. The crayfish and fishing cards each have one photo only. Left out: SustainableTourism-Green.png (a 352 by 111 badge graphic, appears in the footer of every page), the footer logo, and the five Instagram feed pictures on the home page (all named image-asset.jpeg), because their captions credit a photographer handle (@happy.dayz.imagery) on some and they are Instagram posts. Gallery: all 16 come from the site's Gallery page, Our Story page, tours page or home page, and none carries a credit; a person should still glance at Family Friendly.jpg (square, a family of four on a boat) and the other people photos, since their origin could not be confirmed without opening them. Not used because the gallery is capped at 16: Whale tail.jpg (portrait, 2294 by 2450), Couple (Large).jpg (square), Selfie.jpg, Reefwalker Glass Off.jpg, About Photo.jpg, Front on.jpg, Reefwalker 2.jpg, Kalbarri Sun Rise (Large).jpg, Crayfish-Tours-12.jpg. No bot check, captcha or 403 was hit on the site. The site's robots.txt blocks named AI crawlers; pages were read one at a time with the default curl user agent, about 10 requests in all.
